I found a high-severity defect in this diff, and I reported it with the findings tool.

1. **`ApiControllerBase.cs:30`: the new catch-all reports failures as successes (confidence: high).**
   - `catch (Exception)` returns `Ok(new { status = "completed" })`, so any unexpected error reaches the client as HTTP 200. The exception is also swallowed without logging.
   - For example, a `NullReferenceException` or a repository fault during Approve or Reject would show the user "completed" even though the invoice state may not have changed. Monitoring would never see a 500 and there would be no log entry to investigate.
   - Retrying clients may stop retrying after a false success. Clients that do retry may repeat a side effect that already happened.
   - The made-up `{status:"completed"}` body also doesn't match what `Ok(action())` normally returns.
   - The fix is to remove the catch. Unhandled exceptions will then produce ASP.NET's default 500, or you can log the exception and return `StatusCode(500, ...)`.

2. **`ApiControllerBase.cs:30`: no test covers the new branch (confidence: high).**
   - AGENTS.md says every new rule or endpoint needs tests. Nothing would catch this false-success behavior, or a later fix to it.

I found no other defects in the diff.
